, a leading health intelligence platform and maker of the world’s smallest smart ring, on Monday announced that it has launched its initial public offering of 50M shares of its common stock.

The offering consists of 13.5M shares offered by Oura and 36.5M shares offered by certain of Oura’s existing stockholders. In addition, the selling stockholders intend to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 7.50M shares of common stock.
Oura will not receive any proceeds from the sale of its common stock by the selling stockholders. The initial public offering price is expected to be between $40.00 and $44.00 per share.
The company has applied to list its common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “OURA.”

title: Oura files IPO of up to 50M shares
